payload.name: Preserve all explicitly listed preference traits
payload.description: Use when extracting or updating a preference/admiration memory from a message that explicitly lists multiple distinct qualities, traits, or reasons; ensure every stated attribute is captured.
content: During extraction, if the source message explicitly enumerates several traits or reasons (for example 'brave, selfless, down-to-earth'), preserve each listed attribute in the memory content, either as a full list or as separate memory entries. Do not replace the list with a single broader trait such as 'leadership' that drops some of the stated qualities.
Before ADD, check whether the same subject already has a memory covering some of those traits; if so, UPDATE or MERGE to add the missing stated traits instead of creating a partial duplicate.
Stop after capturing all explicitly stated traits; do not add inferred qualities that are not present in the source text.

solves: When a user explicitly lists multiple distinct traits or reasons for liking, admiring, or evaluating someone, extraction often condenses them into one broader trait and drops the rest, leaving later questions about omitted qualities unanswered. This Skill applies whenever a source message enumerates two or more separate qualities as reasons (e.g., 'brave, selfless, down-to-earth') and a preference/admiration memory is being built or updated. It does not apply when only one trait is named or when the missing information would require inference beyond the stated text.
